# nps_workshop_approval_workflow_settings (Resource)

The `nps_workshop_approval_workflow_settings` resource manages the approval workflow for a single tag: how a user gets a blocked binary approved. A user is offered the workflow of the first of their tags that has one, in tag order, falling back to the tag named `global`. Exactly one workflow block may be set; with no workflow block the tag has no approval workflow, which also stops a lower-precedence tag's workflow from applying to its users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Engineers vote each other's software through.
resource "nps_workshop_approval_workflow_settings" "dev" {
  tag                 = "dev"
  approval_rule_type  = "CDHASH"
  notification_method = "SLACK"

  social_voting {
    local_threshold             = 2
    tag_threshold               = 5
    tags_to_consider_votes_from = ["dev", "sre"]
    require_justification       = true
  }
}

# Everyone else asks the security team, two of whom must agree.
resource "nps_workshop_approval_workflow_settings" "global" {
  tag                 = "global"
  approval_rule_type  = "SIGNINGID"
  notification_method = "SLACK"

  designated_approver {
    approver_tag          = "security"
    threshold             = 2
    chat_channel          = "#santa-approvals"
    require_justification = true
  }
}

# Contractors get no workflow at all: with no workflow block, the global
# workflow above no longer reaches them.
resource "nps_workshop_approval_workflow_settings" "contractors" {
  tag                = "contractors"
  approval_rule_type = "CDHASH"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `approval_rule_type` (String) The type of rule a successful approval creates. The possible values are: `BINARY`, `CDHASH`, and `SIGNINGID`. Required even when no workflow block is set.
- `tag` (String) The tag whose approval workflow this resource manages. The tag must already exist in Workshop. Use `global` for the fleet-wide fallback workflow. Changing the tag forces replacement. May contain only letters, digits, periods, colons, hyphens, and underscores (max 42 characters).

### Optional

- `designated_approver` (Block, Optional) Named approvers decide the request. Exactly one of `approver_tag`, `approver_emails`, or `approver_is_manager` must be set. Mutually exclusive with the other workflow blocks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--designated_approver))
- `notification_method` (String) How requestors and approvers are notified. The possible values are: `NONE` and `SLACK`. The `NOTIFICATION_METHOD_`-prefixed spellings are accepted as aliases.
- `self_service` (Block, Optional) Users approve their own requests. Mutually exclusive with the other workflow blocks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--self_service))
- `social_voting` (Block, Optional) Peers vote on the request. Mutually exclusive with the other workflow blocks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--social_voting))

<a id="nestedblock--designated_approver"></a>
### Nested Schema for `designated_approver`

Optional:

- `allow_tag_approval` (Boolean) Whether the deciding approval may create a rule for every host carrying the workflow's tag rather than only the requestor's hosts. On the `global` workflow this creates a fleet-wide rule.
- `approver_emails` (List of String) Email addresses that may approve.
- `approver_is_manager` (Boolean) Set to `true` to route the request to the requestor's manager. The chat bot opens a group chat with the manager, so `chat_channel` and `threshold` must be left unset.
- `approver_tag` (String) Tag whose users may approve. `threshold` must not exceed the number of users carrying the tag.
- `chat_channel` (String) Chat channel notifications are sent to, which requires `notification_method`. A Slack channel is 1 to 21 lowercase letters, digits, and non-repeating interior hyphens, with an optional leading `#`. Leave unset to have the chat bot ask the requestor to pick an approver.
- `require_justification` (Boolean) Whether the requestor must provide a justification.
- `threshold` (Number) Number of approvals required. Required with `approver_tag` or `approver_emails`.


<a id="nestedblock--self_service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `self_service`

Optional:

- `require_justification` (Boolean) Whether the requestor must provide a justification.


<a id="nestedblock--social_voting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `social_voting`

Optional:

- `local_threshold` (Number) Votes required to approve the software for the requestor alone. Required when the block is present.
- `require_justification` (Boolean) Whether the requestor must provide a justification.
- `tag_threshold` (Number) Votes required to approve the software for every user the workflow's tag covers. Required when the block is present, and must be at least `local_threshold`.
- `tags_to_consider_votes_from` (List of String) Tags whose users' votes count toward the thresholds. Defaults to the workflow's own tag.
